hints.title: Deepest Subtree Depth
hints.text: A common ancestor spans all deepest leaves if its left and right subtrees reach the exact same maximum depth.

hints.title: Post-Order Depth Comparison
hints.text: From each node, recursively compute the maximum depth of both child subtrees.

hints.title: Return Node or Promote Child
hints.text: If left depth equals right depth, current node is the lowest common ancestor of its subtree. Otherwise, return the candidate node from the deeper child.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Finding leaf depths first then finding common ancestors requires multiple passes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simultaneously bubbling up the deepest leaf ancestor and maximum depth takes single-pass linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize identical problem formulation to 865 and implement post-order depth comparison.
complexity.notes: Every node in the tree has a unique value.
